pr_body:
# What does this PR do?

This PR adds a new `image_guided_detection_v2` method, which unlike the original method, leverages the objectness head to get the top predicted object in the query image.

It also fixes the documentation example which has bad threshold values.

Fixes #26920

comments:
Hi,

Yes that documentation example requires an update. I've noticed that running the image guided detection with OWLv2 is pretty sensitive to the threshold values. Using `threshold=0.9`, `nms_threshold=0.3` in the `post_process_image_guided_detection`  method gives better results. See the bottom of my [demo notebook](https://github.com/NielsRogge/Transformers-Tutorials/blob/master/OWLv2/Zero_and_one_shot_object_detection_with_OWLv2.ipynb).

Could you open a PR to update the threshold values, as well as the expected values [here](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/src/transformers/models/owlv2/modeling_owlv2.py#L1604-L1623)?

@NielsRogge Thank you for your fast reply. In fact, parameter between Huggingface document and your demo notebook are the same, and the only difference is the query image you use. After changing the query image, the outcome Huggingface document produced is the same as in demo notebook. It seems that the image guided detection is quite sensitive.
Furthermore, tweaking the parameter in documentation example can't yield satisfying result if the original image is input as reference.

Hi @c1ekrt,

I've opened a PR to address this, and I've also updated my [demo notebook](https://github.com/NielsRogge/Transformers-Tutorials/blob/master/OWLv2/Zero_and_one_shot_object_detection_with_OWLv2.ipynb) to illustrate the image guided detection in more detail. Hope that helps!

review_comments: The docstring should detail what the method does and how it differs from image_guided_detection

Is this the naming that the model uses i.e. does the paper use "image_guided_detection_v1", "image_guided_detection_v2"? 

As so much of this logic is shared - couldn't we control this with a flag in the original `image_guided_detection` method?
